about_the_game:
■Story

Recently, the protagonist quit his job.

In order to reflect on himself, he looks back on his life and recalls the faces of the people he has encountered along the way.

■Overview

This is a short memory game that uses human faces.
Match a pair of identical faces to clear them from the table.
If you flip the same card twice without finding its pair, you will lose one life.
Clear all the cards before losing three lives to complete the stage.

■Assist

If you set "Assist" to "On" in the settings, you will be able to see which cards have not yet been flipped.

(A card with a white border indicates that it has not been flipped yet.)

■Play Time

Approximately 30 minutes to 1 hour.

■Streaming & Video Guidelines

You are free to record and share gameplay videos of this game, including livestreams, without needing prior permission—whether as an individual or a company. Please follow these guidelines:

  • Include a link to this page in the video description or equivalent section.

  • Monetization is only allowed when using the official features provided by each video platform.

  • Any content that violates laws or public order and morals is strictly prohibited.

  • The developer assumes no responsibility for any damages arising from the posting or streaming of videos.

These guidelines are subject to change without prior notice.
